item.title: Dr. Delirium and the Edgewood Experiments | Official Trailer | discovery+
item.description: From 1955 to 1975, the US Army used its own soldiers as human guinea pigs in research involving powerful, mind-altering drugs. Told through exclusive footage and first-hand accounts, this is the true story of one of the darkest chapters in US history. Premieres June 9th, 2022, on Discovery+
